headlines.description: Diego Gómez scored another stunner as Brighton enjoyed a happy homecoming by climbing to second in the Premier League with a 2-0 win over 10-man Brentford at the Amex Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Title challengers? In-form Brighton see off Brentford to go second

headlines.description: Florian Wirtz scored his first Premier League goal of the season as Liverpool beat struggling Crystal Palace 3-1 at Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak, Wirtz-inspired Liverpool return to winning ways vs. poor Palace

headlines.description: Another Evanilson goal helped fire Marco Rose's Bournemouth to an eighth straight victory with a hard-fought 2-1 win at Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Evanlison fires Bournemouth past Ipswich for eighth straight win

headlines.description: Sunderland ended their winless run in the Premier League with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Chelsea at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso's Chelsea fall to defeat at PL strugglers Sunderland

headlines.description: Two goals down inside four minutes against Aston Villa in the Premier League on Sunday and trailing 4-2 going into second-half added time, Manchester United rallied to a 4-4 draw on another night of mayhem and drama at Old Trafford.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United twice come from two goals down to salvage point against Aston Villa

headlines.description: A double from Fermín López saw Barcelona come from behind to defeat Atlético Madrid 2-1 on Sunday and restore their three-point lead at the top of LaLiga.
headlines.shortLinkText: López double leads Barcelona past Atleti to go clear atop LaLiga

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic scored as AC Milan bounced back from a shock Europa League defeat with a 2-1 victory away at Genoa on Sunday.
